programmes.programName: Ph.D. in Quality, Reliability and Operations Research
programmes.department: Statistical Quality Control and Operations Research Division
programmes.evidence: The current official division page explicitly lists its PhD in Quality, Reliability and Operations Research. Institute PhD rules independently identify QROR as one of five actual degree-registration disciplines requiring original thesis research; this is a formally named doctoral field, distinct from the QROR master's.
limitations: The current division page establishes the programme at division level; it does not assign seven independent PhD routes to its seven geographic units.

branches.conclusion: One institute-wide formal PhD discipline, QROR, verified by current division listing and opened institute doctoral regulations. Other technical disciplines are named Statistics, Mathematics, Quantitative Economics and Computer Science in regulations, but their formal doctoral specialties were not fully adjudicated.
No business-school branch established; university-wide division inventory not completed.

sources.note: Full current SQC & OR division page opened; named QROR PhD separate from MTech and MS.
Nine-page official rules opened; QROR one of five registration disciplines for an original research PhD.
Official prospectus too large for web reader; not used as verifying source.

limitations: Other institute doctoral branches and formal named specialties remain to adjudicate; current scope partial.
One imported faculty doctorate remains discovery only.
